title: French firm Tellia lands $5M to bring voice AI to agriculture
content: Tellia has raised $5 million in pre-seed funding to scale its voice AI technology for farmers, agronomists, and field teams.
raw_content: San Francisco- and Paris-based agtech startup Tellia has raised $5 million in pre-seed funding to scale its voice AI technology for farmers, agronomists, and field teams. The round was led by Revent, with participation from Grey Silo Ventures, Jeriko, and Fund F, as Vestbee was informed. - Founded in 2024 by Coline Labadie de Faÿ and Vincent, Tellia is developing a voice-first interface that helps agricultural teams capture and access operational data without relying on screens, forms, or manual data entry. - The platform allows users to share information through phone calls, voice notes, text messages, WhatsApp, and email. Tellia converts these inputs into structured records linked to the relevant field, crop, crew, and operation, while also allowing teams to ask questions and receive operational or agronomic insights. - Tellia has already gained traction in the US, where it launched first. The company reports 80% daily active usage among field teams within two months of onboarding. Its deployments include agricultural producer Campos Brothers Farms and Duckhorn wineries. - The startup is also expanding its footprint in Europe, with deployments involving the Institut Français de la Vigne et du Vin (IFV), Val de Gascogne, and German plant breeder KWS Saat. Details of the deal - The new funding will support the rollout of Tellia’s agentic AI suite, further development of its voice AI technology, expansion across the US and Europe, and team growth. - Tellia is also developing API integrations that allow agritech platforms to embed its technology directly into their products. This enables users to capture and structure field data through voice while allowing Tellia’s partners to add new functionality without rebuilding their existing platforms.

title: Tellia Raises $5 Million to Bring Voice AI to Farm Fields
content: Tellia announced a $5 million pre‑seed round on September 8, 2026, led by Revent with participation from Grey Silo Ventures, Jeriko and Fund ...
raw_content: Tellia Raises $5 Million to Bring Voice AI to Farm Fields - ReventCompany - Fund FInvestor Tellia announced a $5 million pre‑seed round on September 8, 2026, led by Revent with participation from Grey Silo Ventures, Jeriko and Fund F. The capital will fund expansion of its voice‑AI platform that converts spoken field updates into structured agronomic data, accelerating growth in the US and Europe. Tellia raised $5 million in a pre‑seed financing on September 8, 2026, with Revent as lead investor and Grey Silo Ventures, Jeriko and Fund F participating. The round backs the San Francisco‑based startup’s voice‑AI solution that captures farm‑field observations via phone calls, texts, voice notes, WhatsApp or email and translates them into structured records linked to fields, crops and crews. Deal Terms The $5 million injection is classified as a pre‑seed round; the company did not disclose a post‑money valuation or equity percentage. Revent, the lead, is a venture firm focused on deep‑tech, while Grey Silo Ventures is the corporate arm of Cereal Docks Group, bringing ag‑industry expertise. Jeriko, operated by Techmind, and Fund F round out a syndicate that spans both the United States and Europe, reflecting Tellia’s trans‑Atlantic go‑to‑market strategy. Market Context Tellia’s technology addresses a persistent friction point in ag‑tech: the reliance on manual data entry in the field. By allowing workers to speak updates in natural language, the platform creates an “agentic data layer” that can be consumed by downstream farm‑management software. Early deployments show strong adoption – 80 % daily active usage among US field teams within two months – and include customers such as Campos Brothers Farms, Duckhorn wineries, the Institut Français de la Vigne et du Vin, Val de Gascogne cooperative, and German breeder KWS Saat. The funding will be used to build an API‑driven agentic layer and to expand the team across both continents. The round underscores growing investor appetite for niche SaaS solutions that combine AI with vertical‑specific workflows. Voice‑first interfaces are still emerging in agriculture, and Tellia’s early traction suggests a path to become a data‑capture standard that can be embedded in larger ag‑tech stacks. As the company scales, it will need to navigate data‑privacy regulations in Europe while maintaining the rapid product iteration that has driven its early US adoption. Overall, the financing positions Tellia to deepen its foothold in a market where real‑time, low‑friction data capture can translate directly into yield‑improving decisions, positioning the startup as a potential infrastructure layer for the next generation of farm‑management platforms. Why It Matters For Tellia, the new capital accelerates product development and hiring, enabling the rollout of its API‑based agentic layer that can be integrated into existing farm‑management suites. This could shift the competitive dynamics with other ag‑tech SaaS providers that rely on manual data entry, forcing them to either partner with Tellia or develop competing voice solutions. Competitors such as Granular or Climate FieldView may need to augment their UI to retain customers seeking hands‑free data capture, while larger ag‑industry players could view Tellia as a strategic acquisition target to embed voice capabilities into their broader portfolios. Key Points - Tellia closed a $5 million pre‑seed round led by Revent, with Grey Silo Ventures, Jeriko and Fund F participating - The platform converts spoken field updates into structured agronomic records via multiple communication channels - US deployments achieved 80 % daily active usage within two months, including Campos Brothers Farms and Duckhorn wineries - European customers include IFV, Val de Gascogne cooperative and KWS Saat - Funding will be used to build an API‑driven agentic layer and expand the team in the US and Europe Analysis The $5 million pre‑seed raise places Tellia at a valuation range typical for deep‑tech agritech startups, likely between 8‑12 times its projected ARR once the platform reaches commercial scale. Voice‑AI is a nascent vertical within SaaS, and Tellia’s early adoption rates suggest a strong product‑market fit that could justify premium multiples as investors chase category‑defining infrastructure. For operators, the ability to capture field data without screens reduces friction, potentially boosting net revenue retention for downstream SaaS platforms that integrate Tellia’s API. Investors will watch the round as a bellwether for capital flowing into niche AI‑driven SaaS solutions that solve real‑world workflow gaps, especially in sectors where mobile connectivity and language diversity are challenges. If Tellia can scale its agentic layer across additional crops and regions, it could command valuation multiples comparable to early‑stage data‑infrastructure plays, reinforcing the case for early‑stage bets on specialized AI SaaS.
